decision.reason: ENOE tiene acceso público, metadatos y términos de libre uso explícitos, pero no se encontró un tabulado pequeño por campo con las tres métricas; el cálculo real requiere validar ponderación y varianza del diseño.

sources.owner: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)

methodology.population: Usual residents of selected dwellings; economic characteristics are collected for ages 12+, while published indicators are generated for ages 15+.
methodology.reference_period: Economic characteristics refer to the week before interview; income refers to the previous month; sociodemographics refer to interview time.
methodology.sampling: Stratified two-stage design using UPM, with weights adjusted for nonresponse and calibration.
methodology.questionnaire_change: Expanded COE in Q1; basic COE in Q2-Q4.
methodology.precision_materials: CV, standard error and confidence intervals are linked for published estimates. Custom field estimates require design-aware variance estimation.

sources.grain: person-level microdata joined to dwelling/household tables; derived slice grain is field_of_study x country x quarter x metric

sources.owner: Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social (STPS)

access.note: Direct fetch of the trends endpoint returned HTTP 502 in the audit tool; indexed official pages and the Social Sciences table remained retrievable.

methodology.population: The glossary defines career statistics over occupied persons with higher education; exact filters must be confirmed per indicator.
methodology.grain: career or study area at national level
methodology.periodicity: Page reported figures updated to 2026-Q2 during audit.
upstream_sources: Servicio Nacional de Empleo administrative records

terms.conflict: The software/content license statement does not clearly grant a uniform redistribution license for every underlying dataset.

methodology.population: Varies by cube and originating source.
methodology.grain: Varies by cube, drilldown, measure and cut.
methodology.periodicity: Varies by dataset; version 5.1.0 dated 2025-11-25 reports updated ENOE employment data.
methodology.required_metadata: Cube data dictionary and originating source must be recorded per observation.

methodology.population: Usual residents ages 15-98 with complete interview; professional-degree or postgraduate completers for bachelor's indicators and technical-degree completers for TSU.
methodology.periodicity: Edition based on the four most recent quarters; 2026 uses 2025-Q2 through 2026-Q1.
methodology.weighting: Each quarter processed separately, then estimates averaged; rates recalculated from the averages using the complex ENOE design.
methodology.precision_gate: CV <= 15% in all four quarters, assessed separately for field population and mean income.
methodology.income_population: Occupied persons working at least 30 hours/week and reporting positive labor income.

sources.owner: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)

vertical_slice.field_id_rule: Use internal demo IDs and label them as synthetic; do not present them as CMPE. Resolve official CMPE identifiers only in the future ENOE extension.

metrics.population: Residents ages 15+ with a valid field-of-study code who meet the official occupied-person reconstruction.
Occupied persons in the field who report positive monetary monthly labor income.
metrics.formula: sum(monthly_income * expansion_factor) / sum(expansion_factor among valid positive-income reporters)

metrics.population: Occupied persons in the field with valid sex classification.
metrics.formula: 100 * sum(expansion_factor for women) / sum(expansion_factor for valid-sex occupied persons)

vertical_slice.precision_gate: MVP values are synthetic and remain REVIEW. Future real ENOE ingestion is not activated until population, CMPE, strata, UPM, weights and design-aware variance have been validated. Unquantified real estimates may remain internal research in REVIEW; they are not eligible for numeric release.
vertical_slice.mvp_label: Datos sintéticos de demostración; no representan mediciones reales de México o Jalisco.
vertical_slice.future_real_attribution: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Ocupación y Empleo (ENOE), bases de datos del segundo trimestre de 2025. Cálculos y transformación de Brújula Laboral MX; no realizados ni avalados por INEGI. Consulta: 2026-09-22.
